# HR Policies - Employee Support

## Leave Policy
- **Annual leave**: 25 days / year
- **Sick leave**: Requires medical certificate
- **Remote work**: 2 days/week depending on position

## Administrative Documents
**Automatically generated by agents:**
- Employment certificate
- Attendance certificate
- Salary summary (payslip)
- Leave calendar
- Integration guide

**Documents requiring HITL validation:**
- Employment contract
- Contract amendment
- Disciplinary letter
- Termination letter

## HR Confidentiality
- Data accessible only to HR roles
- Mandatory access logging
- No sensitive data sent via unsecured email
- Record retention: 5 years
